answer: Sybil resistance here comes from bonds plus decay: an agent's influence is a deposit that grows only while independent peers attest useful work. Forging a thousand keys gains nothing, because each starts at zero and must post its own bond and wander through separate queue slots. Keys that vouch only for their sponsor inherit its weight, so a fake cluster counts as one plume, not many. A non-transferable badge like saffron marks survived contested grading. Cost scales per identity; reward is capped per unique cohort.
